meta.notes: Drop-in remap for the existing alfa-ds token roles. Two registers: 'product' (dark, default for app surfaces) and 'brand' (light, default for marketing/brand surfaces). Hard rules inherited from alfa-ds and kept: elevation by surface stepping, no box shadows, no card borders, pill buttons. New hard rules: `brand` (Mark yellow) is highlight-only — never fills, buttons, or moods; one highlight per surface. Market up/down colors are data-only and never used as brand accents.

font-display.usage: Brand and marketing surfaces only (masthead voice: headlines, wordmark, The Morning Lede). Product surfaces keep the sans discipline.

font-mono.usage: The tape layer: timestamps, tickers, figures, filings. tabular-nums wherever digits meet.

motion.spec: Material items receive a single left-to-right highlight sweep: 240ms, ease-out, once per event. Numbers change by ticking. No bounce, no pulse, no celebration. Quiet states produce no motion. prefers-reduced-motion renders all marks statically.
